# Harbour Town Council: Bus Fares in 2026

Press release, 12 February 2026.

The council voted on 10 February 2026 to keep the single adult bus fare at 2.40 EUR
until 31 December 2026. The proposal came from councillor Jonas Berg; councillor Marta
Ruiz voted against it. "We will not raise fares this year, unless fuel prices rise
again," said Jonas Berg after the vote.

Ridership fell by 49.6% during the 2020 closures and has since recovered to 94% of the
2019 level. The first bus now leaves the harbour at 05:45 and the last one at 23:10.

| Route              | Weekday buses | Saturday buses |
|--------------------|---------------|----------------|
| 1 Harbour–Station  | 64            | 40             |
| 2 Harbour–Hospital | 38            | 22             |
